how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: Everything you need to know about delivery, the deposit, rain and more.
how.deliveryBody: We deliver between 8 AM and 9 PM to any public court or address. Delivery and pickup is free within 5 km of downtown Victoria and {fee} elsewhere in Greater Victoria. Prefer to grab it yourself? Choose pickup at checkout.
how.returnBody: We collect the machine at the end of your rental. Please have it powered off, with the balls back in the bucket. We check the machine and battery together with you.
how.depositBody: Your rental is charged when you book. The deposit is separate: a temporary hold on your card for short rentals, or a saved card for week and month rentals. It's released as soon as the machine is back in good condition.
how.rainBody: This is Victoria — we get it. If it's pouring on your rental day, message us and we'll move your booking to the next available slot at no cost.
how.cancelBody: Cancel 48 hours or more before your start time for a full refund. Inside 48 hours you get 50% back. You can cancel or reschedule anytime from “My bookings”.
how.ballsBody: Use pressureless tennis balls — they keep the same bounce for months and feed consistently. Pressurized balls go flat and can jam the feeder. Our ball bucket add-on includes 100–120 pressureless balls.
how.a1: No. Book with your email or phone number. To manage bookings later, sign in with a one-time code sent to you.
how.q2: Is the machine hard to use?
how.a2: Not at all. We walk you through it at drop-off and you get a quick-start guide. Most players are hitting within five minutes.
how.q3: Can I use it for pickleball?
how.a3: Yes — the PONGBOT Aura feeds pickleballs too. Let us know in the booking notes.
how.a4: Accidents happen. Tell us right away. Normal wear is on us; damage from misuse may be deducted from the deposit, and we'll always explain why.
how.a5: Any court where ball machines are allowed. Please respect posted court time limits and share with other players.
